title: Terms of use
intro: By using web3.toys you agree to these terms. They are written to be short and readable.

sections.title: Education only
list: Everything on web3.toys is for learning. Nothing here is financial, investment, legal or tax advice.
Crypto is risky. You can lose all the money you put in. Do your own research and talk to a qualified adviser before you invest.

sections.title: Your account
list: You must be 18 or over to create an account or buy anything.
Keep your login safe. You are responsible for what happens in your account.
We may remove accounts that cheat, spam or abuse the site, including faking scores or coins.

sections.title: Coins
list: Coins are points on this site only. They have no cash value.
Coins can never be withdrawn, sold, transferred or exchanged for money, crypto or tokens.
Coins unlock small cosmetic extras on this site. We may change how coins are earned or spent.

sections.title: Certificates and Pro tags
list: Certificates show you finished a toy or passed a quiz on web3.toys. They are not a professional qualification.

sections.title: Purchases
list: Prices are shown before you pay, in Indian rupees or US dollars. Taxes are added where the law requires.
Digital products (reports, certificates, exports and books) are delivered as downloads in your account straight after payment.

sections.title: Project listings and custom toys
list: Payment does not guarantee listing. Every project passes our vetting checklist first, and we refund in full if we decline.
We may remove a listed course or toy if we later find the project is misleading, unsafe or breaks the law.

sections.title: Calls
list: Calls are general guidance for learning, not personal financial advice. See the Refunds page for missed or moved calls.

sections.title: Content and templates
list: Agreement templates and tool results are starting points only. Have a qualified lawyer in your country review any agreement before signing.

sections.title: Limits of our responsibility
list: We do our best to keep information accurate, but we cannot promise it is complete or up to date.
To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for losses from decisions you make using this site.
